questions.subtopic: Unit Operations in Dairy and Food Engineering: separation and concentration
questions.question: Which of the following statements about separation and concentration operations in dairy and food processing are CORRECT?

options.A: A cream separator uses centrifugal force to separate milk fat from skim milk based on their density difference.
options.B: Reverse osmosis uses a semi-permeable membrane and an applied pressure exceeding the osmotic pressure to remove water from a solution.
options.C: Ultrafiltration can be used to concentrate milk proteins while allowing lactose and minerals to pass through the membrane.
options.D: In a centrifugal clarifier, the denser sediment/debris collects near the axis of rotation while the clarified milk moves toward the periphery.

questions.solution:
Q.63 Solution:• Correct Answer: A, B, C• Section: Agricultural Engineering | Sub-topic: Unit Operations in Dairy and Food Engineering: separation and concentration | Type: MSQ | Marks: 2Q.63   Unit Operations in Dairy and Food Engineering: separation and concentrationType & Marks: MSQ — 2 marksQuestion:Which of the following statements about separation and concentration operations in dairy and food processing are CORRECT?(A) A cream separator uses centrifugal force to separate milk fat from skim milk based on their density difference.(B) Reverse osmosis uses a semi-permeable membrane and an applied pressure exceeding the osmotic pressure to remove water from a solution.(C) Ultrafiltration can be used to concentrate milk proteins while allowing lactose and minerals to pass through the membrane.(D) In a centrifugal clarifier, the denser sediment/debris collects near the axis of rotation while the clarified milk moves toward the periphery.Answer: A, B, CDetailed Explanation:(A) is correct: centrifugal force, acting on the density difference between fat globules and the aqueous phase, drives the lighter fat toward the axis and the heavier skim milk toward the bowl wall in a cream separator.
